name: Backdoor Cut
idea: If a defender blocks your pass, cut behind them to the basket.
why: When a defender jumps in front of you to stop a pass, the space behind them is wide open. Go there!
tryit: Take two steps toward the ball like you want it, then plant your foot and burst to the basket.

frames.say: {2} wants the ball, but {X2} is standing right in the way so {1} can’t pass.
{2} pretends to come get the ball. {X2} follows, still blocking the pass.
*Backdoor!* {2} suddenly cuts behind {X2}, straight to the basket.
{1} throws a bounce pass to the cutter.
Easy layup! When a defender blocks the pass, go behind them.
